ColdLight Data Attribute Vocabulary — SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH

PRIMITIVES (behavior/accessibility):
- kind: identifies the primitive type (e.g., "button", "dialog", "select")
- slot: identifies the part within a primitive (e.g., "trigger", "content", "item")
- state: tracks interactive state (e.g., "open", "closed", "active", "inactive")
- id: user-defined stable ID for testing/tooling

RECIPES (visual styling):
- surface: background treatment (glass, matte, solid)
- material: texture/depth (void, deep, smoke, frost)
- motion: animation behavior (subtle, smooth, energetic)
- transition: state change animation (fade, slide, scale)
- focus: attention/emphasis level (low, medium, high, critical)
- layers: z-index layer (base, overlay, modal, toast)

See README.md and PRIMITIVE_CONTRACT.md for usage patterns.

Common state values for primitives.

readme.text:
# ColdLight Design System

> **The design system for DevPulse.**

---

## Documentation

| Document | Purpose |
|----------|---------|
| [Design Book](

`
CONFIG (config/coldlight/)
    |
    v
TAXONOMY (taxonomy/) <- ALL CONTRACTS LIVE HERE
    |
    +--- kinds/primitives/{kind}/contract.ts
    +--- api/adapter/{adapter}/contract.ts
    |
    v
PRIMITIVES (primitives/) <- Structure + State
    |
    v
BLOCKS (blocks/) <- ARIA APPLIED HERE
`

---

## Key Principles

1. **Taxonomy is truth** - All contracts in taxonomy/
2. **One contract per kind** - No duplicates, no scattered declarations
3. **ARIA at block level** - Primitives have no ARIA baked in
4. **dsAdapter abstraction** - MeltUI hidden behind import cloak

---

## Folders

| Folder | Purpose |
|--------|---------|
| config/ | Configuration (adapters, roots, enforcement) |
| taxonomy/ | SSOT contracts, scanner, registry |
| primitives/ | ColdLight components (structure + state) |
| api/adapters/ | dsAdapter implementations |
| blocks/ | Accessible units (ARIA applied here) |
| semantics/ | Primitives + recipes |
| tokens/ | Design tokens |
| recipes/ | Appearance system |
| patterns/ | Documentation guidance |
| docs/ | Design Book and reference docs |

---
